decision.note: The approved option splits the 46 conflicting relation-direction edges into 8 kernel edges scheduled for repair and 38 non-kernel edges moved to a separate gap. It records the split only: no edge is repaired, no direction is reversed and the separate gap is not registered here.

gapBinding.reason: KGA-G04 is the k-surface delivery-order cycle bound to be-sdk and stack-editions. Recording which edges are repaired where does not repair them, so the P0 gap stays open under its human dependency-semantics decision.

immutableRefs.note: Approval intake, EPOCH-03 chain, registry, gap addendum, gap inventory, the KGA-D02 record and the generated node universe are read by digest only; application state lives in the application-state ledger.

invariants: The approved split is a governance record, recorded PLANNING_ONLY, VALID_BLOCKED and gated NO_GO: 8 kernel edges are scheduled for repair and 38 non-kernel edges are moved to a separate gap.
Scheduling a repair is not performing one: no edge is repaired or rewritten, no dependsOn or blocks direction is reversed, and edgesRepaired stays 0.
The generated node universe stays byte-untouched at 650 nodes; no node, edge, parent or projection is written and no source extraction is performed.
The split accounts for every conflicting edge: 8 kernel plus 38 non-kernel equals the committed 46, over 35 affected nodes and the five committed kernel conflict nodes.
The separate gap for the 38 non-kernel edges is not registered here: gapCreated stays false and gapId stays null, deferred to human gap registration.

KGA-D02 stays byte-identical and its canonical edge application stays deferred to KGA-D07 and undischarged; D02 never permitted edge repair in its own scope and this record does not perform it either.
KGA-G04 stays a P0 open gap: recording where each edge is repaired does not close the k-surface delivery-order cycle.
When the repair is eventually performed the executor is human-developer-only; no code start, runtime or readiness is authorized by this record.
The registry keeps all ten decisions pending and unselected; the closure intake and EPOCH-03 chain are read by digest only.
No planning artifact here is runtime implementation evidence, a code-start permit or a readiness claim.
nonGoals: do not repair, rewrite, add, delete or reverse any dependsOn or blocks edge for the 46 conflicting relations
do not mutate any generated node, parent, owner or projection, and do not perform source extraction
do not register, number or file the separate gap that will hold the 38 non-kernel edges
do not discharge the KGA-D02 canonical edge application deferral or rewrite the KGA-D02 record
do not close KGA-G04 or treat a recorded split as a resolved delivery-order cycle
do not authorize code start, runtime, readiness, release or deploy, and do not write platform or kernel product code

rollback.trigger: any edge is repaired, rewritten or reversed, a generated node is mutated, the 46/8/38 split or its node measurement drifts, the separate gap is registered, the KGA-D02 record bytes drift or its deferral is discharged, or a fail-closed gate flag flips
rollback.action: revert this disposition record, its application-state row, the attestation contract, tests, pack sections and gate wiring as one shard
